title: Wise Platform / graphic language

location.extent: Complete published video; PNG is one poster frame

slide_intent: Adapt an established identity for another audience because shared ownership need not mean identical expression.
strategic_value: Layered green panels, diagrams and restrained layouts can connect Wise Platform with the parent while addressing enterprise concerns.
demonstration: The film sequences layered interface panels, event graphics, large typography, icons, a growth chart and a globe with a monetary figure.
practical_value: Compare which parent-brand elements remain useful when the story shifts from personal use to infrastructure.
